subject.title: Campbell Union School District Board, Trustee Area 5

text: I am a proud product of California's public education system. From elementary school through my master's degree, my journey showed me the transformative power of accessible, quality public education. Now, as a parent, I want my son and every student in Campbell Union School District to have that same opportunity.
I will fight for our children to have the best education and support possible. I will ensure that the district is fiscally responsible and doesn't waste your tax dollars.

At Stanford University, I work with project managers on diverse construction projects, giving me experience in budgeting, long-range planning, and facilities management. As the Chair of Stanford's LBRE Engagement Council, I know how to be an inclusive, forward-thinking leader.

Public education faces several challenges, but with CUSD's homegrown leadership, we have a strong foundation. Kids learn best when they are supported, both in and out of the classroom. The goal is progress, not perfection. I want students to be inspired to be lifelong learners and not just learn for the sake of testing. I will put students first and ensure our schools empower and inspire every child to grow and succeed.
I'm endorsed by the previous trustee who spent 22 years on the board. www.electsamkrowlucal.com

text: As a decade-long district parent, former corporate executive, and community leader, I am running for the Campbell Union School District Board of Trustees (Area 5) to bring practical oversight, fiscal responsibility, and inclusive leadership.

My priorities are ensuring strong fundamentals in reading, math, and science, smaller class sizes, and a well-rounded education with arts, music, and physical education—equipping elementary students with practical skills to succeed in high school.

To achieve this, I bring a Post Graduate Diploma in Management and expertise in budget oversight to ensure public funds directly support classrooms. In elected roles on the School Site Council and PTA Executive Board, I scaled hands-on learning labs, spearheaded multicultural events, and earned recognition as Forest Hill's Volunteer of the Year. Both of my children attended CUSD from preschool onward.
I will bring a strategic business mindset and a mother's heart to foster open, transparent communication between the board, educators, and families.
Proudly endorsed by local teachers, neighboring school board trustees, and over 300 parents and community members, I respectfully ask for your vote.
Backed by parents. Guided by educators. Focused on students.
